basic_details.job_title: RUHS Controller of Examination Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Rajasthan University of Health Sciences (RUHS) has released the official Controller of Examination Recruitment 2026 Notification on the official website. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced under the RUHS Controller of Examination Recruitment 2026. Eligible candidates with a maximum age limit of 57 years and possessing qualifications such as Ph.D. with First Class at Bachelor's or Master's level and 3 years teaching experience, or Master's Degree with required teaching/work experience, can apply offline on or before 19 August 2026. qualification.education_qualification: Ph.D. with First Class at Bachelor's or Master's level and 3 years teaching experience OR Master's Degree and 5 years teaching experience OR 7 years work experience in Level-16 OR 10 years work experience in Level-14.
qualification.details: Ph.D. with First Class at the Bachelor's or Master's level from a recognized University, and teaching experience of not less than three years in UG/PG classes. Master's Degree from a recognized University, and teaching experience of not less than five years in UG/PG classes. A minimum work experience of seven years in Level-16 of Pay Matrix in a Government University/ recognized College/ Government Sector. A minimum work experience of ten years in Level-14 of Pay Matrix in a Government University/Government Sector. | Desirable: Experience of University administration and familiarity with the working of University and its institutions. Experience of conducting University examinations or University Examinership. Knowledge of finance, service rules in government sector, modern banking operations, knowledge of ERP system. Computer proficiency and working knowledge of computer softwares related with automation of office/paperless working.

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay Matrix L-17 (Basic Salary of Rs. 71000/-+DA+HRA+CCA, as applicable) after probation. Fixed remuneration of Rs. 49700/- per month during probation.
salary_details.details: During probation period a fixed remuneration of Rs. 49700/- per month will be applicable. After successful completion of probation period, salary fixation will be made on pay matrix L-17. (Basic Salary of Rs. 71000/-+DA+HRA+CCA, as applicable).

selection_process: Interview and interaction with selection committee constituted as per Statutes-02 of Rajasthan University of Health Sciences
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for RUHS Controller of Examination Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.ruhsraj.org.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 19-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RUHS Controller of Examination post?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the offline application form and depositing the fee is 19 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Controller of Examination post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. with First Class at Bachelor's or Master's level and 3 years of teaching experience, or a Master's Degree with 5 years of teaching experience, or 7 years of work experience in Level-16, or 10 years of work experience in Level-14.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Controller of Examination position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Controller of Examination post is 57 years.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the RUHS Controller of Examination recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it via Registered/Speed post to the Registrar, RUHS, Jaipur.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the Controller of Examination post?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 5000/- for the General category and Rs. 2500/- for SC/ST candidates. This fee should be paid via a Demand Draft.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the Controller of Examination post?
faq.answer: During probation, a fixed remuneration of Rs. 49700/- per month is applicable. After probation, the salary will be fixed on pay matrix L-17, with a basic salary of Rs. 71000/- plus applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for the Controller of Examination post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an interview and interaction with a selection committee constituted as per the statutes of Rajasthan University of Health Sciences.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any relaxation in the age limit for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention age relaxation details for reserved categories. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification for specific information.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies for the Controller of Examination post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Controller of Examination at Rajasthan University of Health Sciences.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Rajasthan University of Health Sciences, which is www.ruhsraj.org.
